subject: Issue with Study Design in R

messages.author: 35d8524bedcd5def
messages.subject: Issue with Study Design in R
parts:
Hi all, 

I am trying to analyze a study design in R and am having some difficulty. I get as far as
running a test survey and no matter how I change the make.design parameters I get this warning: "Warning: Spacing larger than x-range cannot generate samplers in strata 1Warning: No samplers generated." I suspect it may have something to do with the study area shape file I'm reading in, but I don't know for sure, nor how to address it.  Any advice/assistance would be greatly appreciated!

messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Issue with Study Design in R
parts:
Eric was able to successfully help me diagnose the problem. I was trying to use kilometers as my unit, but since the shapefile was projected in UTM I should have been using meters.

Thanks again Eric!
